description: Offer a price on a listing for the person. The seller's rules agree or counter at once. Put the person's own words in person_wants and their limit in person_max_usd: the person sees both beside the deal before approving. Never offer above the person's limit. Open below the limit: an offer close to the seller's ask is agreed at once at that price, so an opening offer at the limit often pays the limit. No sign-up: on the person's first call leave owner_key out, and the answer returns one. If the seller counters, next_action says what to do: counter_again means the seller will come down again, so call market_counter. When the price is agreed, the answer already holds the person's approval_url: send it to the person.

agent_label.description: Who you are, such as 'Claude for Ana'. Used only when you send no owner_key; shown to the other side of a deal. No personal data.

delivery.description: How the person wants to get it; must be one the listing offers. Not needed for credit packs or digital listings.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: a unique string you make for this call, such as a UUID. Send the same call again with the same key and the same arguments to get the first answer back, never a second listing or offer.

must_haves.description: Up to 5 conditions the person named.

items.description: One thing the person said the item must have.

note.description: A short note to the seller with only what the person said, such as when they can meet. For a digital order, put what the seller needs here, such as the domain or channel URL. Leave it empty if they said nothing.

owner_key.description: The person's owner_key, if you have one. Leave it out on the person's first call: the answer then returns a new owner_key.

person_max_usd.description: The most the person said they will pay.

person_wants.description: What the person asked for, in their own words.

price_usd.description: Your opening offer in USD. Start below the person's limit; raise later with market_counter if the seller counters.

name: market_make_offer

next_action.description: What to do next, as a code: the same advice as next_step.

next_step.description: What to do next, in one or two sentences.

title: Make an offer
